 Versus  The State of Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Naresh Chandra Verma,Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Narendra Kumar Singh,APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 20-02-2023 Heard the parties.

The petitioners have moved this Court for quashing of the First Information Report of Kateya P.S.
Case No. 247 of 2021 registered for the offence punishable under Section 376(D) of Indian Penal Code and under Section 4/6 of POCSO Act.

In this case, case diary was called for and learned APP after going through it submitted that the police during the investigation, tried to arrest the petitioners herein and failure to do so, the process under Section 82 and 83 of the Cr.P.C. against both of them already issued.
He next intended that there is nothing on record/case diary to show that the petitioners are/were not in India at the time of occurrence.

Confronted with the said submission of the learned Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.884 of 2022(3)
dt.20-02-2023 APP, learned counsel for the petitioners submit that he may be permitted to file supplementary affidavit bringing on record each and every pages of the passport of the both petitioners to show that the petitioner no. 1 and 2 left India on 06.03.2018 and 17.01.2019 respectively and thereafter, they never returned.
